name: Nexa Redirects - 301s & 404 Log
author: NexaCMS
description: Redirection style: manage 301/302 redirects in pre and log 404s so you can fix broken links. Redirects can keep selected GET parameters (e.g. theme) across the jump. Rules are per-site: main-site redirects never reroute subsites, and local targets stay inside the current site.
